form.label: AD Account & Computer Search
form.description: Look up Active Directory user accounts and computer objects (LDAP via SA-ldapsearch) and correlate them with Windows Security events. Click a row to drill down.

search.query: | ldapsearch domain="$domain$" search="(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user)(|(sAMAccountName=$acct$)(cn=$acct$)(displayName=$acct$)(mail=$acct$)(userPrincipalName=$acct$)))" attrs="sAMAccountName,displayName,userPrincipalName,mail,title,department,manager,description,userAccountControl,lockoutTime,lastLogonTimestamp,pwdLastSet,whenCreated,whenChanged,memberOf,distinguishedName" | eval Status=case(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE")),"Disabled", isnotnull(lockoutTime) AND lockoutTime!="0" AND lockoutTime!="1601-01-01T00:00:00Z","Locked", true(),"Enabled") | eval PwdNeverExpires=if(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"DONT_EXPIRE_PASSWD")),"Yes","No") | eval lastLogon_e=coalesce(strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"),strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")) | eval pwdLastSet_e=coalesce(strptime(pwdLastSet,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"),strptime(pwdLastSet,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")) | eval DaysSinceLogon=if(isnull(lastLogon_e) OR lastLogon_e<0,"never",round((now()-lastLogon_e)/86400,0)) | eval PwdAgeDays=if(isnull(pwdLastSet_e) OR pwdLastSet_e<0,"never",round((now()-pwdLastSet_e)/86400,0)) | eval Manager=replace(mvindex(split(manager,","),0),"^CN=","") | eval Groups=mvcount(memberOf) | eval OU=replace(distinguishedName,"^CN=[^,]+,","")

| ldapsearch domain="$domain$" search="(&(objectClass=computer)(|(name=$comp$)(dNSHostName=$comp$)))" attrs="name,dNSHostName,operatingSystem,operatingSystemVersion,description,managedBy,userAccountControl,lastLogonTimestamp,pwdLastSet,whenCreated,whenChanged,distinguishedName" | eval Status=if(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE")),"Disabled","Enabled") | eval Role=case(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"SERVER_TRUST_ACCOUNT")),"Domain Controller", match(operatingSystem,"(?i)server"),"Server", true(),"Workstation") | eval lastLogon_e=coalesce(strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"),strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")) | eval DaysSinceLogon=if(isnull(lastLogon_e) OR lastLogon_e<0,"never",round((now()-lastLogon_e)/86400,0)) | eval ManagedBy=replace(mvindex(split(managedBy,","),0),"^CN=","") | eval OU=replace(distinguishedName,"^CN=[^,]+,","")

index="$idx$" source="*WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4624,4625,4740,4771,4776) (user="$acct$" OR Account_Name="$acct$" OR Target_User_Name="$acct$") (dest="$comp$*" OR ComputerName="$comp$*" OR src="$comp$*" OR Workstation_Name="$comp$*") | eval user=lower(coalesce(user,Target_User_Name,mvindex(Account_Name,-1))) | search user!="*$" user!="-" user!="anonymous logon" | eval dest=lower(coalesce(dest,ComputerName)), src=coalesce(src,Source_Network_Address,Workstation_Name,"-") | eval Result=case(EventCode=4624,"Success",EventCode=4740,"Lockout",true(),"Failure") | fields _time user dest src EventCode Result Logon_Type Failure_Reason Status Sub_Status
| stats count
| where Status!="Enabled" | stats count
| stats count
| where Result="Failure" | stats count
| where Result="Lockout" | stats count

panel.title: AD accounts — click a row for details

search.query: | table sAMAccountName displayName mail title department Manager Status PwdNeverExpires DaysSinceLogon PwdAgeDays Groups whenCreated OU | sort sAMAccountName

| search sAMAccountName="$sel_user$" | fields memberOf | mvexpand memberOf | eval Group=replace(mvindex(split(memberOf,","),0),"^CN=",""), Privileged=if(match(Group,"(?i)^(Domain Admins|Enterprise Admins|Schema Admins|Administrators|Account Operators|Backup Operators|Server Operators|Print Operators|DnsAdmins|Group Policy Creator Owners)$"),"YES","") | table Group Privileged memberOf | sort -Privileged Group

index="$idx$" source="*WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 (user="$sel_user$" OR Target_User_Name="$sel_user$") | eval dest=lower(coalesce(dest,ComputerName)), src=coalesce(src,Source_Network_Address,Workstation_Name,"-") | stats count AS Logons values(Logon_Type) AS LogonTypes values(src) AS Sources min(_time) AS First max(_time) AS Last BY dest | convert ctime(First) ctime(Last) | sort -Logons
| search user="$sel_user$" | timechart count BY Result

index="$idx$" source="*WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4720,4722,4723,4724,4725,4726,4738,4740,4767,4728,4729,4732,4733,4756,4757) (Target_User_Name="$sel_user$" OR Member_Name="*$sel_user$*" OR user="$sel_user$") | eval Action=case(EventCode=4720,"Created",EventCode=4722,"Enabled",EventCode=4723,"Pwd change attempt",EventCode=4724,"Pwd reset", EventCode=4725,"Disabled",EventCode=4726,"Deleted",EventCode=4738,"Changed",EventCode=4740,"Locked out", EventCode=4767,"Unlocked",in(EventCode,4728,4732,4756),"Added to group",in(EventCode,4729,4733,4757),"Removed from group") | eval By=mvindex(Account_Name,0), Group=coalesce(Group_Name,"") | table _time Action By Group ComputerName EventCode | sort -_time

panel.title: AD computers — click a row for details

search.query: | table name dNSHostName Role operatingSystem operatingSystemVersion Status DaysSinceLogon ManagedBy description whenCreated OU | sort name
| stats count BY operatingSystem | sort -count

index="$idx$" source="*WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4624,4625) (dest="$sel_comp$*" OR ComputerName="$sel_comp$*") | eval user=lower(coalesce(user,Target_User_Name,mvindex(Account_Name,-1))) | search user!="*$" user!="-" user!="anonymous logon" | eval Result=if(EventCode=4624,"Success","Failure"), src=coalesce(src,Source_Network_Address,Workstation_Name,"-") | stats count(eval(Result="Success")) AS Success count(eval(Result="Failure")) AS Failure values(Logon_Type) AS LogonTypes values(src) AS Sources max(_time) AS Last BY user | convert ctime(Last) | sort -Success

index="$idx$" source="*WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4741,4742,4743) Target_User_Name="$sel_comp$*" | eval Action=case(EventCode=4741,"Created",EventCode=4742,"Changed",EventCode=4743,"Deleted"), By=mvindex(Account_Name,0) | table _time Action By ComputerName EventCode | sort -_time

| where Status="Enabled" AND (DaysSinceLogon="never" OR tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)>$stale$) | table sAMAccountName displayName department DaysSinceLogon PwdAgeDays PwdNeverExpires OU | sort -DaysSinceLogon
| where Status="Enabled" AND (DaysSinceLogon="never" OR tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)>$stale$) | table name operatingSystem Role DaysSinceLogon OU | sort -DaysSinceLogon

panel.title: Top failed-logon accounts (password spray / brute force indicator)

search.query: | where Result="Failure" | stats count AS Failures dc(dest) AS Targets dc(src) AS Sources values(Sub_Status) AS SubStatus BY user | sort -Failures | head 20
